name: Nervous System Functioning
subject: Nervous System Functioning
description: This topic covers the structure and subdivisions of the nervous system, how they enable conscious and unconscious responses to sensory stimuli, the role of neurotransmitters and neuromodulators in synaptic transmission, and synaptic plasticity as the fundamental mechanism of learning and memory.

subtopics.name: The Neural Synapse and Synaptic Transmission
